Shared-library backend examples

Source: vignettes/shared-library-backends.Rmd
shared-library-backends.Rmd

qgsim can orchestrate simulation engines implemented outside R while keeping the common workflow:

breeding_scheme() -> qgsim_compile() -> qgsim_validate()
                  -> qgsim_run() -> qgsim_result

The repository includes two small developer examples:

  • C++ shared-library backend
  • Fortran shared-library backend

Each example demonstrates the backend stages translate(), execute(), and collect(), calls a toy native function from a shared library, and converts the output into a valid qgsim_result.

These examples are optional, compiler-dependent developer guidance. They are not scientifically complete simulators, are not built during qgsim installation, and are not required by the package test suite. Building them requires a compatible C++ or Fortran compiler configured for R CMD SHLIB.

Developed by qgsim authors.
